title: Jelly Jackpot
tagline: Stack wobbly kitchen junk on a spinning cake. Gamble. Catch the cheater.
description: Open a case every turn to see which ridiculous rule you got, then drop a rubber chicken, a toaster or a jiggling jelly onto a shared cake tower. Bet on whether your friends' pieces stand or fall. One of you is secretly the Saboteur, rigging cases with cursed cards. Vote them out at the end.
howToPlay: On your turn, press Space to open a case: a reel lands on a rule and a multiplier for this turn.
Move the mouse to hover your piece over the cake, rotate it, then click to drop it.
If the tower stands you earn coins × the multiplier. If anything falls off, you lose coins × the multiplier.
When it's not your turn, bet STAND or FALL on the other players' drops.
One player is the secret Saboteur who can rig a case once per round. Vote them out at the end!
